raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`/v1/embeddings` returns the `EmbeddingResponse` Pydantic model to FastAPI. Without a
`response_model`, FastAPI runs `jsonable_encoder` over it, a recursive pure-Python walk that copies
every float of every embedding, before `ORJSONResponse` serializes the copy. The cost grows with the
number of floats in the response, so it shows most on requests that carry many embeddings. The chat and completions routes already avoid this with `model_json_response`, which serializes the
model once with pydantic-core.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py`: `/v1/embeddings` returns
  `model_json_response(...)`, as `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions` do. Error responses
  pass through unchanged.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_embedding_responses.py` (new, CPU): the route returns JSON
  bytes equal to `EmbeddingResponse.model_dump_json(by_alias=True)`.

## Accuracy Tests

Ran `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` model on one RTX A6000. 32 synthetic texts (8 to 8,430 tokens), sent one per request, as batches in several orders, and concurrently. Each embedding is compared with the FP32 SentenceTransformer reference and the min cosine similarity was ~0.99986 (with and without this change)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Setup: 1x RTX A6000, `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` (1024-dim), `--is-embedding
--tokenizer-worker-num 8`, main = `74c08f3d`, same image and GPU for both. AIPerf 0.13.0 on
`/v1/embeddings` on synthetic dataset, request-count timing: 20 warmup and 200 measured requests per concurrency lane.
Each value is the mean of 3 runs with different dataset seeds
Cell = input tokens x texts per request x concurrency


| Cell | main emb/s | this PR emb/s | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 32x16x1 | 159.3  | 189.2 | **+18.7%** | 
| 512x16x1 | 95.3  | 108.2 | **+13.5%** | 
| 32x1x64 | 631.9 | 633.8 | +0.3% | 
| 32x16x64 | 974.7 | 965.0 | -1.0% | 
| 512x1x64 | 129.7 | 129.7 | 0.0% | 
| 512x16x64 (1 run) | 130.7 | 130.7 | 0.0% | 


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -1832,8 +1832,10 @@ async def openai_v1_chat_completions(
 )
 async def openai_v1_embeddings(request: EmbeddingRequest, raw_request: Request):
     """OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint."""
-    return await raw_request.app.state.openai_serving_embedding.handle_request(
-        request, raw_request
+    return model_json_response(
+        await raw_request.app.state.openai_serving_embedding.handle_request(
+            request, raw_request
+        )
     )

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+"""JSON encoding of the OpenAI `/v1/embeddings` route, checked without a server."""
+
+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from fastapi import Response
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import (
+    EmbeddingObject,
+    EmbeddingRequest,
+    EmbeddingResponse,
+    UsageInfo,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestEmbeddingResponses(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_openai_embeddings_route_serializes_the_response_model_once(self):
+        """The route hands back JSON bytes, so FastAPI's recursive
+        jsonable_encoder never walks the float vectors."""
+        response_model = EmbeddingResponse(
+            data=[EmbeddingObject(embedding=[0.25, -0.5], index=0)],
+            model="m",
+            usage=UsageInfo(prompt_tokens=3, total_tokens=3),
+        )
+
+        class FakeServing:
+            async def handle_request(self, request, raw_request):
+                return response_model
+
+        raw_request = SimpleNamespace(
+            app=SimpleNamespace(
+                state=SimpleNamespace(openai_serving_embedding=FakeServing())
+            )
+        )
+        response = asyncio.run(
+            http_server.openai_v1_embeddings(
+                EmbeddingRequest(input="hi", model="m"), raw_request
+            )
+        )
+
+        self.assertIsInstance(response, Response)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            response.body, response_model.model_dump_json(by_alias=True).encode()
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
